headline: Governor can certify data centers as environmental leadership projects
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

California gives the Governor the power to certify data center projects as environmental leadership development projects under CEQA. Passed.

121 measures in 33 jurisdictions would pause data centers, or add conditions on building and running them.

197 measures in 43 jurisdictions cite the fear that anyone can now fake anyone.

2,227 measures tracked. 752 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 102 offices.
